sources.title: GDPR — baseline (legal basis & rights)
sources.why: Sets the high Recital 26 bar for true anonymization and the user rights, including erasure, that this dimension covers.

sources.title: Data monetisation / third-party sharing
sources.why: Warns that 'de-identified' datasets stay health data if re-identification is feasible, directly testing anonymization adequacy.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — health data (special category)
sources.why: Defines the sensitive health data that must be erasable or genuinely anonymized to leave GDPR scope.
